description:
Headroom shows where every gigabyte on your Mac goes, helps you get space back safely, and makes your own files easy to find.

YOUR FILES, BY KIND
Images, videos, music, documents and archives on shelves with big previews. Quick Look with Space, a live inspector, folder sizes at a glance, and drag several files out at once.

SEARCH THE WAY YOU'D SAY IT
"pdfs from last week over 5 mb", "screenshots with wifi password", "zips older than 6 months". Headroom shows how it read you as chips you can take off. It even finds the words inside your screenshots, read on your Mac.

QUICK SEARCH FROM ANYWHERE
Press Control-Option-Space in any app for files, apps and System Settings pages in one place.

WORKSPACES
Put a project's folders and files on one page, wherever they live: Documents, Downloads, iCloud Drive or a drive. Nothing is copied or moved. See what changed lately at a glance, and jump between workspaces with Control-1 to 9.

TIDY THE DESKTOP
One click puts loose files into folders by kind: Screenshots, Images, PDFs, Documents, Installers. You see the plan first, and Undo puts everything back.

DUPLICATES AND CLEAN-UP
Identical files and look-alike photos, old installers, forgotten downloads, old screenshots and screen recordings, and big old videos, each on a card with what it frees. Everything goes to the Trash after you confirm, never deleted for good, with Undo.

FOR DEVELOPERS
Git branch in the path bar, and one key to open any folder in your terminal or editor.

SEE THE WHOLE DISK
A map of your folders by size, plain-English explanations of what a folder is and whether it's safe to remove, and a notch and menu bar glance at your free space.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no analytics, no network. Text recognition and duplicate detection run on your Mac.
promotionalText: Your Mac's disk, explained, and your files, finally findable. Everything stays on your Mac.
